description: This is a single-seater, modern recliner chair upholstered in dark gray leather. It features a plush, segmented backrest designed for comfort and support, along with generously padded armrests. The chair has a clean, contemporary design with subtle stitching details along the edges. A subtle lever or handle is visible on the right side, suggesting its reclining functionality. The overall aesthetic is one of comfort and relaxation, making it suitable for personal use in a home entertainment setting or a cozy reading nook.
